summary: Current framing (cross-system fingerprint + actionable attribution) fails adversarial review; analysis/resource pivot survives.
subject: memory-failure-attribution direction, after the P2 retrieval intervention null
reviewer_method: two fresh independent Claude reviewers (attack then adjudication); Codex backend not used per project model policy

details.attack_memo: This direction measures its own construction, and its one causal test fails. The headline — null end accuracy (0.407/0.423/0.429; McNemar p=0.736/0.728/0.864) paired with 'significantly different' failure fingerprints (Stuart–Maxwell, Holm <=2.7e-4) — is in substance a restatement of how the three baselines were built. A fact-extraction engine loses at formation (F1 18); a session summarizer at context (F5 21); a raw-turn retriever at retrieval (F4 35) — because each was authored with exactly that bottleneck. On a single benchmark, over 100 questions, this is a taxonomy of the authors' own pipeline choices, not a phenomenon about memory systems. The lone LongMemEval replication is n=10; the round-3 human gate covers 48/100 headline questions. The test that would turn a taxonomy into a finding is the intervention, and the project's own pre-registration records it as failed: retrieval recall on the 35 F4 questions rises 0.043->0.321, yet accuracy yields +7 net flips on 34 paired questions, McNemar p=0.143, bootstrap 95% CI [-0.029,+0.441]. A no-op placebo re-ask alone flips 9/35 wrong->correct. When repairing the measured stage is statistically indistinguishable from re-asking the question, the attribution carries no demonstrated actionable value. That is diagnostics without utility — and it is the project's own stated kill line.

decomposed_points.label: Construction-confounded fingerprint
decomposed_points.attack_claim: The fingerprint merely restates how the three baselines were authored, one bottleneck per architecture; no black-box system or ablation breaks the confound.
decomposed_points.evidence: Stage mapping matches memory_systems.py architectures exactly (semantic formation recall 0.473/F1 18; summary context 0.258/F5 21; verbatim retrieval 0.197/F4 35). No third-party system or architecture ablation exists in the artifacts.
decomposed_points.recommended_fix: Run a Mem0/A-MEM-class system and/or an extraction-vs-raw ablation, and reframe as architecture-conditional failure localization.

decomposed_points.label: Single benchmark / weak replication
decomposed_points.attack_claim: Evidence is one benchmark; the LongMemEval replication is n=10 and cannot support a cross-benchmark phenomenon.
decomposed_points.evidence: Pilot is full-haystack longmemeval_s_sample10 (verbatim retrieval 0.60), not the degenerate oracle run; but it does not reproduce the null-accuracy premise (summary 0.125 vs ~0.56). Single-benchmark limitation stands.
decomposed_points.recommended_fix: Scale full-haystack LongMemEval to n=50-100 or scope the paper to LoCoMo.

decomposed_points.label: Human gate covers only 48/100
decomposed_points.attack_claim: The headline attribution rests on the automatic gate (kappa 0.07) for 52/100 questions.
decomposed_points.evidence: 48 covered / 52 uncovered confirmed. Re-gating preserves the pattern (F1 18->20, F5 21, F4 35; E0 21->18/23->18/19->21). Stage tests were not rerun on human-gated labels, and stage labels themselves were not human-audited.
decomposed_points.recommended_fix: Rerun stage-distribution tests E0-excluded or on the 48 human-gated rows; add a blind human audit of stage attribution.

decomposed_points.label: Intervention failed pre-registered rule
decomposed_points.attack_claim: Repairing the measured retrieval stage failed its own rule: +7 net flips, p=0.143, CI includes 0.
decomposed_points.evidence: placebo 9 vs repair 16 on 34 paired questions; net +7; p=0.1435; CI [-0.0294,+0.4412]; decision.success=false. The design's own falsifier (placebo moves >=3/35) triggered at 9/35.
decomposed_points.recommended_fix: Do not scale blindly: repeat arms, human-verify F4 labels, then test the n=200 (~70 F4) subset under a fresh pre-registration; or demote contribution 4 to null.

decomposed_points.label: Placebo floor kills actionable value
decomposed_points.attack_claim: A no-op re-ask flips 9/35, so attribution has no demonstrated actionable value and hits the kill line.
decomposed_points.evidence: Inference is fair, but 'statistically indistinguishable' overstates a failed-to-reject at n=34; the CCF-B kill line does not cleanly trigger, while the roadmap pre-registers the analysis-paper fallback. The 26% retest instability also weakens the F4 label base rate.
decomposed_points.recommended_fix: Execute the pre-registered analysis-paper pivot; treat actionability as dead until a powered repair beats the retest floor.

details.net_assessment: Current framing would not survive as the phenomenon+actionability paper. Two critical attacks (construction confound; intervention null) are unrebuted. A separate confound: hash:384 embeddings may manufacture the verbatim retrieval bottleneck. What survives is an instrument/resource paper: attribution protocol, human-audit methodology, and the corrected oracle ladder.
top_action_items: Break the construction confound: run a black-box/third-party memory system and/or architecture ablation; reframe as architecture-conditional.
Resolve contribution 4 honestly: repeat arms + human-verified F4 labels + n=200, or demote to null and pivot.
Solidify measurement (E0-excluded stage tests, human stage audit), scale LongMemEval full-haystack, and move off hash:384 (bge-m3 available locally).
details.independent_confound: Every run uses the deterministic hash:384 embedding fallback; the verbatim retrieval bottleneck may be an embedding artifact. Decisive free check: recompute retrieval with local bge-m3.
